title: task_done
description: Mark a task done with a hand-off note (the same gates as `task <ID> done`: tests first, commit, allowed paths, quick checks).

note.description: What was done and what is left.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.

skip_checks.description: Mark done although the quick checks failed; the reason is recorded.
